Luxurious Upgraded Garden Villa | Frond O, Palm Jumeirah | Royal Atlantis Views

Step into refined elegance with this fully upgraded 4-bedroom + maid’s room garden villa located on the prestigious Frond O of Palm Jumeirah, offering breathtaking views of the iconic Royal Atlantis resort.

Villa Highlights:

Spacious 4 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
Generous 5,660 sqft Built-Up Area
Expansive 7,336 sqft Plot with Lush Gardens
Panoramic Royal Atlantis Views

Exceptional Features & Upgrades:

Impressive Double Height Living Area flooded with natural light
Private Infinity Pool with an elegant sunken deck, perfect for relaxation and entertaining
Designer interiors furnished by Minotti and Henge for timeless luxury
Unique Art Pieces curated from Louis Vuitton and Hermes collections
Custom Bespoke Show Kitchen with adjoining Dirty Kitchen
State-of-the-art Miele Appliances throughout
Ample storage with 16 Full-Size Wardrobes
Exclusive Watch Winding Cabinet for the discerning collector

Unmatched Palm Jumeirah Lifestyle:

This villa captures the essence of Palm living — privacy, sophistication, and spectacular waterfront vistas. With direct access to pristine beaches and the world-class amenities of Palm Jumeirah, it’s an entertainer’s dream and a family sanctuary.
